stem: A hospital evaluates outcomes from its new-graduate transition-to-practice program. Which outcome set matches measures used in NCSBN's national study?

options.A: Competence, safety practices/errors, work stress, job satisfaction, and retention
options.B: Only salary satisfaction and parking availability
options.C: Only medication-administration speed with no safety measures
options.D: Only patient census and hospital construction costs

rationale: NCSBN's Phase I Transition to Practice study evaluated outcomes including competence reported by new nurses and linked preceptors, self-reported errors, use of safety practices, work stress, job satisfaction, and hospital retention data. These multidimensional outcomes reflect both practice safety and workforce transition.
educational_objective: Identify the types of safety, competence, and workforce outcomes used to evaluate new-graduate transition programs.
source_organization: National Council of State Boards of Nursing (NCSBN)
source_claim_supported: Supports competence, errors/safety practices, stress, satisfaction, and retention as studied transition outcomes.
correction_summary: Replaced a vague correlation claim about staff satisfaction with a directly documented NCSBN program-evaluation construct.
audit_findings: A reproduces the documented outcome domains; B-D omit the clinically relevant study measures.
blueprint_locator: 2026 NCLEX-RN Test Plan, Management of Care, printed p.7 / PDF p.11
